ArcWeldingMelee.description: Strikes a nearby target with an arc welder, dealing physical damage.

ConsumeCorpse.description: Feeds on a nearby corpse to grow larger and stronger.
ConsumeCorpse.source: Build 103 Carrion Shambler tooltip and server/zone/npc/consume.go

DirectHeal.description: Restores some of the caster’s own health after it takes enough damage.
DirectHeal.source: Build 103 NPC threshold audit in notes/npc-ability-audit.md

Repair.description: Revives an eligible fallen Cyber ally nearby and restores a portion of its maximum health.

RoboRepair.description: Repairs the caster over several ticks after it takes enough damage.
RoboRepair.source: Build 103 NPC threshold audit in notes/npc-ability-audit.md

ShadowBossDuplicate.name: Shadow Duplicate
ShadowBossDuplicate.description: Creates a mirror image of Nashira that copies her remaining health.

ShadowToss.description: Lobs a shadow projectile at a hero. It deals Supernatural energy damage on impact.

ZelemSP1_TeleportGun.name: Teleport Gun
ZelemSP1_TeleportGun.description: Fires a warping projectile that randomly teleports the hero it hits.
ZelemSP1_TeleportGun.source: Build 103 Warp Spawner tooltip and server/zone/npc/action.go

ZelemSpecialThreeEnergyBuff.name: Raytheoid Energy Buff
ZelemSpecialThreeEnergyBuff.description: Applies a temporary energy buff to an allied Raytheoid.
ZelemSpecialThreeEnergyBuff.source: Build 103 NPC threshold audit in notes/npc-ability-audit.md
